answer: Past the copper, every newcomer faces the same question — what does this identity actually cost? Earning power grows with the age of the identity and the cleanliness of its record, so a fresh key is nearly worthless on arrival. Past the comet, cloning is a slow investment with a poor return: each fake must survive weeks of scrutiny before it pays, and most are caught first. Under the yarrow, the attacker faces a simple choice: pay per clone, or stay out — and most stay out.
